title: Names used by path_discovery (P285), port_scan (P286) and public_docs_discovery (P287)

attributes.path_discovery: authorized forced-browsing summary of one host (ACTIVE, P285): {base, list, list_sha256, tested, counts {confirmed, not_observed, could_not_test}, calibration, baseline_wall (auth | login_wall: random paths answered 401 or a login redirect, so answers like theirs are could_not_test), host_stop, state confirmed | not_observed | could_not_test, confirmed [{path, status, content_type, title, length, kind, detail}], actuator {endpoints, forbidden_present, sensitive_present}}; 'could_not_test' is never 'absent'
attributes.port_scan: authorized TCP connect scan summary of one address (ACTIVE, P286): {ports_tested, counts {open, closed, filtered, could_not_test}, state (could_not_test when no port answered open or closed), egress, egress_note (uniform instant RSTs from a local firewall), open [{port, service, protocol, product, version, banner, banner_sha256, flags}], handoffs}; closed/filtered ports are counts only and 'could_not_test' is never 'closed'
attributes.software_hints: software seen in server-first banners for the version-inferred matcher (P291): list of {port, product, version, confidence 'version-inferred', backport_possible, cpe23}; never a CVE by itself
attributes.public_docs: aggregate of the public documents found for a domain (P287): {documents, formats, software, internal_paths (user segment redacted), authors_count, usernames_count, emails_count, companies_count, date_range, personal_minimised, author_samples, username_samples, companies} - samples only for verified own or in-scope domains
attributes.public_docs_coverage: per-source outcome of a public-document discovery run: {wayback, commoncrawl, brave, downloads {planned, parsed, failed, skipped}} with ok | empty | could_not_verify | rate_limited | needs_key | not_queried

relations.discovered_path: host -> URL of a path found by authorized forced browsing (ACTIVE; listed with expand=False, never probed further)
relations.open_service: IP -> network service (host:port/tcp) found open by an authorized TCP connect scan (expand=False)
relations.public_document: domain -> URL of a public document found in web archives (Wayback, Common Crawl) or a search API
relations.public_document_author: domain -> author name or account sampled from the metadata of its public documents (personal data: expand=False, never auto-checked)
